properties.vocals: The band's vocals are characterized by expressive and theatrical delivery, often blending falsetto and dynamic shifts to complement their dramatic musical style.
properties.biography: HMLTD formed in London and quickly gained attention for their unique fusion of glam rock aesthetics with modern indie and experimental rock sounds. The band members, including Henry Spychalski and Dylan Brady, brought together their diverse musical influences to create a sound that is both nostalgic and forward-thinking. Their performances are noted for their dramatic flair and visual storytelling, helping them build a dedicated fanbase and critical acclaim in the UK and beyond.
properties.known_for: Their theatrical performances, genre-blending music, and bold artistic expression.
properties.description: HMLTD is a British art rock band formed in London, known for their eclectic blend of glam rock, indie rock, and experimental sounds. The band combines theatrical performances with a diverse musical palette, incorporating elements of post-punk and alternative rock. Their music often features dramatic vocals, bold instrumentation, and a flair for the avant-garde, making them stand out in the contemporary rock scene.
properties.cultural_impact: HMLTD has contributed to the resurgence of glam and art rock aesthetics in modern indie music, influencing a new generation of artists to embrace theatricality and genre fusion in their work.
properties.performance_style: HMLTD's performance style is highly theatrical and expressive, often incorporating dramatic visuals and energetic stage presence to enhance their music's emotional impact.

properties.vocals: Lead vocals (primarily Geordie Greep) alternate between talk-sung delivery, strained high-register outbursts and declamatory storytelling; vocals are theatrical, dynamic and used as an additional rhythmic/tonal instrument rather than a conventional pop lead.
properties.biography: Black Midi formed in London in 2017 while the members were students on the citys music and art circuit. Early shows showcased tight, angular compositions, sudden tempo and dynamic shifts, and highly physical performances that built a dedicated following. Their debut album Schlagenheim (2019), produced by Dan Carey, brought wide critical attention and a Mercury Prize nomination, establishing them as a leading voice in a new wave of experimental British rock. Over the next records they broadened their sound with jazz, orchestral touches and longer narrative songs, while continuing to tour extensively and incorporate guest instrumentalists into their recordings and live shows.
properties.known_for: Complex, tightly-woven rhythms and time signatures, abrupt dynamic and tempo shifts, theatrical live shows and a fearless, avant-garde approach to rock songwriting.
properties.description: Black Midi are an English experimental rock band formed in London in 2017. They quickly gained attention for virtuosic playing, jagged, polyrhythmic songwriting and theatrical live performances. Their debut album Schlagenheim (2019), produced by Dan Carey, earned critical acclaim and a Mercury Prize nomination; subsequent releases such as Cavalcade (2021) and Hellfire (2022) expanded their palette with jazz, noise and narrative-driven suites. The band blends math-rock precision, post-punk energy and avant-garde improvisation, frequently augmenting studio and live line-ups with horns, keys and additional percussion.
properties.cultural_impact: Black Midi helped reframe experimental and math-influenced rock for a contemporary audience, earning major critical recognition (including a Mercury Prize nomination) and influencing a wave of post-punk/art-rock bands in the UK and beyond; theyve been praised for revitalizing improvisation and complexity in modern rock and for highly influential, chaotic live performances.
properties.performance_style: Live shows are high-energy, theatrical and often improvisational, featuring tight, labyrinthine arrangements interspersed with extended jams, abrupt dynamic shifts and a physical, confrontational stage presence.

properties.vocals: Dual-vocal approach with alternating melodic and shouted deliveries; often raw, nasal timbres and chant-like hooks; emphasis on rhythmic phrasing and punk-inflected phrasing rather than wide classical range.
properties.biography: Formed in Orange County, California, The Garden consists of identical twins Fletcher and Wyatt Shears. Beginning as teenagers, they released music independently and developed an aesthetic and philosophy they term 'vada vada' — a refusal to be constrained by genre. Over the 2010s they cultivated a devoted underground audience through a steady output of singles, EPs and albums, distinctive visuals and highly physical live shows that blend punk, surf, electronic and art-rock influences.
properties.known_for: High-energy, chaotic live shows; genre-blurring 'vada vada' aesthetic; twin-fronted, self-directed DIY approach to releases and visuals.
properties.description: The Garden are an American twin-brother duo from Orange County, California, who merge punk attitude, art-punk aesthetics and experimental electronic production into a distinctive, genre-melting sound they describe as 'vada vada.' Self-directed and DIY-minded, they built a devoted underground following through lo-fi releases, intense live shows and a consistent visual/ideological identity that rejects easy categorization.
properties.cultural_impact: The Garden helped popularize a DIY, internet-driven aesthetic within contemporary art-punk and experimental scenes, promoting the 'vada vada' ethos (genre-fluid creativity) and inspiring a wave of young artists who blur punk, electronic and art-rock boundaries.
properties.performance_style: Short, high-energy sets that emphasize physicality and immediacy, with minimal staging and a punk-adjacent tendency to provoke crowd interaction; a blend of live instrumentation and electronic backing.

properties.vocals: Sarah Midori Perry provides clear, bright vocals with a playful and youthful tone, often singing in both English and Japanese. The vocal style complements the band's upbeat and eclectic electronic pop sound.
properties.biography: Kero Kero Bonito was formed in London in 2011 by Sarah Midori Perry, Gus Lobban, and Jamie Bulled. The band quickly gained attention for their innovative blend of indie pop and electronic music, characterized by catchy melodies and bilingual lyrics in English and Japanese. Their early work was heavily influenced by J-Pop and video game music, which helped them carve out a unique niche in the indie music scene. Over time, they have evolved their sound to include more experimental and alternative elements, while maintaining their signature playful style. The band has released several EPs and albums, gaining a dedicated fanbase and critical acclaim for their creative approach to pop music.
properties.known_for: Their unique blend of bilingual lyrics, playful electronic pop sound, and incorporation of J-Pop influences.
properties.description: Kero Kero Bonito is a British indie pop band formed in London, consisting of vocalist Sarah Midori Perry and producers Gus Lobban and Jamie Bulled. They are known for their unique fusion of indie pop, electropop, and synthpop, often incorporating elements of J-Pop and experimental sounds. Their music features playful, upbeat melodies combined with bilingual lyrics in English and Japanese, creating a distinctive and accessible sound that appeals to a diverse audience.
properties.cultural_impact: Kero Kero Bonito has contributed to the popularization of bilingual indie pop music and has influenced the integration of J-Pop aesthetics into Western indie music scenes. Their playful and experimental approach has inspired a new wave of artists blending electronic and pop genres with multicultural elements.
properties.performance_style: Kero Kero Bonito's live performances are energetic and engaging, often featuring playful interactions with the audience and a vibrant stage presence that reflects their eclectic and upbeat music style.

properties.biography: PUP formed in Toronto in 2010, quickly establishing themselves in the punk rock scene with their high-energy performances and candid, often witty lyrics. The band members met through the local music scene and shared a passion for punk and alternative rock, which shaped their sound. Their self-titled debut album released in 2013 received critical praise, and subsequent albums further solidified their reputation as a leading force in modern punk rock. Over the years, PUP has toured extensively, building a dedicated fanbase and influencing a new generation of punk bands.
properties.known_for: Energetic live performances, emotionally raw and witty lyrics, and a modern take on punk rock.
properties.description: PUP is a Canadian punk rock band formed in Toronto, Ontario, known for their energetic and raw punk sound combined with emotionally charged and often humorous lyrics. The band consists of Stefan Babcock (vocals, guitar), Zachary Mykula (drums), Steve Sladkowski (guitar, backing vocals), and Nestor Chumak (bass). They have gained critical acclaim for their intense live shows and albums that blend punk rock with elements of indie and alternative rock.
notable_songs: If This Tour Doesn't Kill You, I Will
properties.cultural_impact: PUP has been influential in revitalizing punk rock in the 2010s, inspiring a wave of new punk bands and gaining a dedicated international fanbase. Their candid approach to mental health and personal issues has resonated widely, contributing to broader conversations in alternative music communities.
properties.performance_style: PUP is known for their high-energy, intense live performances that engage audiences with raw emotion and dynamic stage presence.
